name: Anzu
source:
A maid who works for Himeko. She likes Himeko more than three meals a day. She's capable of knowing Himeko's body weight and her mood with just a single glance.

She doesn't show her emotions much and has a calm and cool demeanor, but when it comes to Himeko, she can get very excitable. Her daily routine involves praising Himeko with compliments she loves to hear. Compliments such as "the general is amazing" or "just as you'd expect from the general". Anzu is very skilled at this.

Because of the relationship Himeko has with the protagonist, she acts a bit cold towards him.

She knows a lot about video games and anime, and secretly looks forward to seeing the competitive Himeko make a face of defeat when she loses in a game.

[spoiler]With the approval of Himeko, Anzu becomes the protagonist's mistress [/spoiler]
